title: Whipped Fish Soup
description: A light and comforting Indian-inspired fish soup made with whipped cream and Malaysian spices.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a pan and sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
2. Add the Malaysian fish curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
3. Add the fish fillet and cook until it turns opaque.
4. Pour in the coconut milk and fish stock, and bring to a simmer.
5. Reduce the heat and let it cook for 10 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
6. Stir in the whipped cream and cook for 1-2 minutes or until heated through.
7. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
8. Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
